depiction.primary_object: round smiling face with open mouth inside corner brackets
modifiers: four rounded corner brackets forming a viewfinder frame
depiction.composition: centered circular face enclosed by four outer corner brackets

readings.meaning: facial recognition / Face ID / biometric authentication
portrait photo / headshot / passport photo / selfie
face detection / camera autofocus on face

ambiguity: Can blend with generic smiley/emoji icons at very small sizes if the corner brackets aren't noticed, or be confused with QR/barcode scanner icons.

modifier_semantics.meaning: camera viewfinder, scanning frame, focus target, or cropping boundary

task_intents: take a passport or visa photo

reasoning: A smiling face inside four viewfinder corner brackets universally represents facial recognition (Face ID, biometric KYC verification, face tagging) as well as framed portrait photos (headshots, passport/ID photos, avatars). It covers a focused set of concrete tasks across tech, travel/admin, career, and photography, though at tiny sizes it could briefly look like a plain smiley or QR scanner.
